title: data-driven-quant-validation-metrics-adapter
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a reusable metrics adapter and CI gating flow that validates FP8/INT8 quantization profiles against task-specific quality metrics. This ticket covers implementation of standardized metric calculators (perplexity, MMLU-style accuracy aggregation, Rouge/BLEU, EM/F1 for QA, BLEU/ROUGE for summarization, reranker NDCG@k, and custom task scorers), wiring them into the existing eval harness, emitting canonical metric names and deltas, and recording results to the Console metrics sink. The goal is to provide deterministic, repeatable validation that maps quant profiles to allowed quality regressions and feeds rollouts/approval automation.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter implements: perplexity (token-level) and normalized delta reporting; MMLU-style top-1 and task-aggregate accuracy; Rouge-L and ROUGE-1/F1; BLEU-4; EM and F1 for QA; NDCG@5 for reranking tasks.
Adapter exposes a consistent JSON metric contract: metric_name, baseline_value, quant_value, delta_pct, sample_count, dataset_name, profile_id.
CI gates: a default quant profile evaluation job runs on PRs touching quant code and fails if any metric delta exceeds configured thresholds for that profile.
Results are sent to Console: per-model/per-profile dashboards show baseline vs quantized curves and pass/fail badges.
Benchmarks run on a held-out validation suite (see tasks list) and reproduce within +/- 0.5% of offline run when re-run on the same commit and model weights.
Documentation page and short how-to for adding new task scorers and datasets in the repo docsite.
tasks: Design metric JSON contract and add schema example to docs (owner: Liam).
Implement perplexity calculator with support for masking and multiple vocab/tokenizers (owner: Eng-Squad Quant).
Implement MMLU-style aggregator that supports per-task weighting and confidence intervals (owner: Data Quality).
Add Rouge/BLEU wrappers (use sacrebleu/rouge-l implementations where possible) and normalize tokenization to model tokenizer.
Implement QA scorers (EM, F1) and tie to sample-level error examples for drift analysis.
Implement NDCG@k and MAP scorers for retrieval/rerank tests with soft-label support.
Integrate adapter into eval harness and add a GitHub Actions job for quant profile PRs.
Instrument Console sink to accept metric contract and surface delta badges on profile pages.
Write docs and a short migration guide for adding new metrics and datasets.
Add unit tests and an end-to-end integration test that runs a small quant profile on CI's toy dataset.
notes: Rationale: existing evals focus on aggregate quality but lack a single adapter layer that normalizes outputs across tasks and makes deltas machine-readable for gating automation.
We need careful tokenization parity between baseline FP32 runs and quantized runs — plan to canonicalize on the model tokenizer and include a small tokenization test suite.

Calibration nuance: some FP8 profiles will change probability mass in tail tokens; report both absolute perplexity and relative perplexity delta. For generative tasks include top-k and nucleus sampling reproducibility notes.

Thresholds proposal (baseline): MMLU drop <= 1.5% absolute, Rouge-L delta <= 2.0 points, BLEU-4 delta <= 1.5 points, perplexity increase <= 6% relative, EM/F1 drop <= 2.0% absolute, NDCG@5 delta <= 3.0% relative. These are tunable per-profile and per-SLO tier.

Validation datasets: small held-out slices of MMLU-like tasks, GLUE-style probes, CNN/DailyMail for summarization, SQuAD v2 for QA, MS MARCO dev set for reranking. For private deployments we will allow customer-provided eval suites through the private harness.
Make adapter extensible: register_metric(name, compute_fn, aggregation_strategy, sample_level_outputs_allowed).
Plan to emit sample-level artifacts (failed_examples.jsonl) for each run so engineers and PMs can inspect qualitative regressions.
Initial implementation should avoid heavy external deps; prefer lightweight wrappers around sacrebleu/rouge packages already vendored in infra.
